votes.motion: Approve the pole relocation for Pole No. 5 on Leominster-Shirley Road as shown on Verizon's maps.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to approve the pole relocation as shown on the maps provided by verizon. ms. bertram seconded. on vote, motion carried, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the pole location.
votes.quote: it was then moved and seconded to close the public hearing.

votes.motion: Waive the $990.00 payment to the Town of Lunenburg Ambulance.
votes.quote: mr. sund motioned to waive the $990.00 payment to the town of lunenburg ambulance. mr. debettencourt seconded.

votes.motion: Approve the revised amount on STM Article 1 by $990.00.
votes.quote: a new motion was then presented by ms. bertram to approve the revised amount on stm article 1 by $990.00. mr. debettencourt seconded. on vote, motion carried, 5 in favor, o opposed.

votes.motion: Establish a Memorial Day Celebration Planning Committee in accordance with the guideline laid out by Selectmen Sund.
votes.quote: town establish a memorial day celebration planning committee in accordance with the guideline laid out by selectmen sund. mr. debettencourt seconded.

votes.motion: Approve the Lions Club Road Block on 05/12/12.
votes.quote: mr. debettencourt motioned for approval for the lions club road block. mr. alonzo seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 recused (bertram)

votes.motion: Approve the Peddler's License and Common Victualler License for Rick's Foods doing business as Harry's Road Side.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved that they approve the two licenses for rick's foods doing business as harry's road side. ms. bertram seconded. on vote, motion carried, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.
being no further business mr. debettencourt made a motion to adjourn. ms. bertram seconded. the board voted unanimously to adjourn the meeting at 9:03 p.m.
